//: Thresholds are gates, not aspirations. Every category here was fixed reactively at least once (de98985, 027f237, 4828d33, 356c236) before this file existed. Raise a number after the site clears it; never lower one to make a build pass.
// baseline: Measured on 2026-09-18 against this commit, desktop preset: performance 1.00, accessibility 1.00, best-practices 1.00, seo 1.00, CLS 0.0002. The 0.95 floors leave room for runner variance; the 1.00 floors do not, because those two have no excuse for slipping.
// compression: The CI job serves the site with a plain static server, which does not gzip, while GitHub Pages does. Performance is therefore measured pessimistically here, which is the safe direction.

assertions.// weighted-zero audits: An audit can score 0 while its CATEGORY still scores 1, because Lighthouse weights some axe checks at zero. That is a green gate guarding nothing, and it already happened here: label-content-name-mismatch scored 0 on four links whose aria-label did not contain their visible text (WCAG 2.5.3) while accessibility read a clean 1.00. Assert those audits by name.
